name: Laser eyes
description: Stare wide-eyed: red laser flares on your eyes, beams where you look.
origin: The “laser eyes” / “red eyes” meme: glowing red lens flares on someone’s eyes when they mean business.
whatHappens: Glowing red flares bloom on your eyes with long red streaks. Turn your head and laser beams fire that way, sparking at the edge of the screen, with a laser hum. It lasts as long as you hold the stare.
how: Keep your hands away from your face, open your eyes wide and raise your eyebrows. Hold the stare for about a second.
tips: A quick surprised look won’t trigger it; hold the stare.
Turn your head while it’s on to aim the beams.
